Why Greater Cleveland Chooses Roubic

Most homeowners don't hire a tree service often. You compare three or four companies, weigh price against trust, and pick the crew that gives you the most confidence the job gets done safely. Here's what Roubic offers that other Greater Cleveland tree companies don't — in specific, checkable terms: 44 years of family ownership, owner {{global.owner_name}} on every job site, a full owned equipment fleet with no subcontracting, and ANSI A300 pruning discipline.

Talk to Aaron — Get a Free Estimate Call {{global.phone}}

Reason 1 · 44 Years in NE Ohio

Family-Owned Since 1982 — One Auburn Township Yard, Two Generations.

Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC was founded by Thomas Roubic in 1982 with a single pickup truck and a single chainsaw, and has been led by his son {{global.owner_name}} since 2017. We've operated from the same Auburn Township yard for 44 years — longer than most national tree-service brands have had Cleveland offices, and longer than many of our customers have owned their homes.

Continuous ownership means continuous accountability. When something needs sorting out on a job, you're talking to the family who owns the company — not a regional manager who gets reassigned next quarter.

The Auburn community gave me my start. Every job we did in the first ten years was somebody's neighbor calling somebody's neighbor. That's still how it works. Thomas Roubic · Founder

That's the difference against a national brand: there's no franchise fee built into your invoice, no rotating regional manager, and no national markup on subcontracted work. Aaron writes the estimate and Aaron is on-site the day of the work.

I visit every job site. That's the difference. It's my name on the truck. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

Common Questions

Why Choose Roubic — FAQ

Five of the questions we hear most from homeowners comparing tree services — with straight answers, not sales copy.

Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC operates as a fully licensed and insured Ohio tree service. We carry general liability insurance and workers' compensation in compliance with state requirements. A certificate of insurance (COI) is available on request — important for HOAs, commercial property managers, and village permit reviews.
How is Roubic different from a national tree-service franchise?
Roubic is family-owned, locally founded, and locally operated from the same Auburn Township yard since 1982. There's no franchise fee built into your invoice, no rotating regional manager, and no national-brand markup on subcontracted work. {{global.owner_name}} — the current owner — runs sales and daily operations and is reachable by phone at {{global.phone}}.
Do you provide free estimates?
Yes. We provide free estimates for tree removal, tree trimming, stump grinding, land clearing, and storm-damage assessment across our 40-mile radius from Auburn Township. For most jobs we can quote on-site in 15–30 minutes, and there's no trip charge.
Why does Roubic refuse to prune oak trees in summer?
Oak wilt is a vascular disease vectored by nitidulid (sap-feeding) beetles in Ohio, and the high-risk window runs roughly April 1 through July 31. Pruning during that window creates fresh wounds the beetles are attracted to, and a single infected cut can introduce oak wilt that kills the tree within two seasons and spreads to adjacent oaks via root grafts. We won't prune your oak in May or June, no matter how badly you want it done — that's the standard, and it protects the tree.
Do you work with insurance companies after a storm?
Yes. Storm-damage and emergency tree-care work routinely involves homeowners-insurance claims when a covered structure has been damaged. We document the work the way adjusters need it — photos, itemized work, species and DBH estimates — and provide it as a single packet so your claim moves through cleanly. We don't negotiate the claim on your behalf, but we eliminate the documentation friction that causes most claim delays.
